label: Sequence starts with g/o: fires near end of input and when first token is echoed back
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.015% of steps). It fires almost only in sequences whose first original token is g or o (87% of activations and mass; lift 17x for g, 9x for o). Within those sequences it fires in two places: the last 1-3 original-phase steps just before <DEL> (strongest in long sequences, L=8-9, orig_idx 7-8), and the copy step with recall_idx=1, where the fed-back input is the first token (in_tok g, 54% of mass). It does not fire at t<3, rarely in the middle of the copy phase, and never on sequences starting with other tokens except a few stray cases. Activations are weak (mean 0.13, max 0.26) and the feature fires on only a small fraction of the qualifying positions, so precision is very low (~0.6%). Longer L makes it more likely to fire. Which g/o sequences trigger it was not identified (second-token and length conditions did not help much).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=o (+4.84), phase=2 & in_tok=g (+3.56), orig0=g (+3.55), phase=2 & out_tok=o (+3.49), orig2=3 (+2.63), orig1=3 (+2.31). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.03), prev3_tok=- (-2.77), in_tok=o (-2.61), prev_tok=o (-2.50).
